title: KLF7 as a biomarker for the pre-metastatic state promotes colorectal cancer liver metastasis via TGFbeta autocrine signaling.
authors: Fang, Xiaozhuang; Huang, Hongyu; Zhao, Zize; Yang, Luoxinyi; Huang, Fan; Li, Jiayi; Meng, Ziqi; He, Shichu; Li, Tianyou; Yang, Shaokui; Suo, Mengying; Lv, Jianying; Chen, Yanan; Zhang, Chunze; Li, Na
one_liner_zh: 该研究用机器学习识别结直肠癌转移前状态并发现KLF7通过TGFbeta信号促进转移，虽涉及转录因子KLF7但未聚焦其与DNA结合机制，方法以组学分析和湿实验为主，缺乏AI/物理模拟的互作建模。
abstract: Although metastasis-initiating cells drive metastasis, only a certain subpopulation of these cells can successfully disseminate from the primary tumor to colonize metastatic sites. The identification and characterization of this subpopulation remain poorly studied. We designated this specific subpopulation as pre-metastatic state (PMS) cells. Identifying biomarkers and understanding the mechanisms underlying PMS formation are vital for preventing metastasis. In this research, we employed machine learning and bioinformatics techniques, integrating data from human cell lines, bulk RNA sequencing, single-cell sequencing, and spatial transcriptomics, to pinpoint PMS and classify its subtypes (PMS1 and PMS2). We revealed that PMS1 exhibits high epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) characteristics and is associated with poor prognosis, while PMS2 is associated with tumor stemness. Notably, KLF7 was identified as a key biomarker of PMS, highly expressed in PMS1 and colorectal cancer liver metastasis (CRLM) lesions. Through dual-luciferase reporter assays and both in vitro and in vivo experiments, we demonstrated that KLF7 promotes EMT characteristics in CRC via TGFbeta autocrine signaling, thereby facilitating CRLM. Moreover, it was determined that the small molecule drug epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG) can inhibit the transcriptional activity of KLF7, thereby suppressing the TGFbeta signaling and EMT. This result highlights EGCG as a promising compound for the treatment of colorectal cancer (CRC) with high KLF7 expression. Through this research, we established a systematic framework defining two PMS subtypes and identified KLF7 as a pivotal driver of CRLM through TGFbeta autocrine signaling.
abstract_zh: 尽管转移起始细胞驱动转移，但只有这些细胞中的特定亚群能够成功从原发肿瘤播散并在转移部位定植。该亚群的鉴定和特征描述仍研究不足。我们将这一特定亚群命名为转移前状态（pre-metastatic state, PMS）细胞。识别生物标志物并理解PMS形成的机制对于预防转移至关重要。在本研究中，我们采用机器学习和生物信息学技术，整合来自人类细胞系、批量RNA测序、单细胞测序和空间转录组学的数据，以精确定位PMS并分类其亚型（PMS1和PMS2）。我们揭示PMS1表现出高上皮-间质转化（epithelial-mesenchymal transition, EMT）特征，并与不良预后相关，而PMS2与肿瘤干性相关。值得注意的是，KLF7被鉴定为PMS的关键生物标志物，在PMS1和结直肠癌肝转移（colorectal cancer liver metastasis, CRLM）病灶中高表达。通过双荧光素酶报告基因实验以及体外和体内实验，我们证明KLF7通过TGFbeta自分泌信号促进结直肠癌（colorectal cancer, CRC）中的EMT特征，从而促进CRLM。此外，确定小分子药物表没食子儿茶素没食子酸酯（epigallocatechin gallate, EGCG）能抑制KLF7的转录活性，从而抑制TGFbeta信号和EMT。这一结果突显EGCG作为治疗高KLF7表达结直肠癌的有前景化合物。通过本研究，我们建立了一个系统框架，定义两种PMS亚型，并鉴定KLF7通过TGFbeta自分泌信号作为CRLM的关键驱动因子。
